title: Atlas DataFlow Candidate Traceability
description: Pipeline-side provenance link connecting run outputs (M14-01 run-evidence) to release candidate artifacts. Records the originating run reference, candidate artifact identities and hashes, and validation status. This schema is a pipeline-internal sidecar — it does not authorize promotion, registry activation, or any lifecycle transition. It records provenance state only. Internal run references must not appear in public metadata.

schema_version.description: Schema version for this candidate traceability record. The const value enables schema version discrimination across the M14 traceability layer.

source_run_ref.description: Reference to the originating pipeline run. Uses stable identifiers aligned with publisher/release-candidate.schema.json source_run vocabulary and pipeline/run-evidence.schema.json run_identity vocabulary. Must not embed raw run evidence content — only stable identifiers and a relative path pointer are permitted.

run_id.description: Stable unique identifier for the originating run. Vocabulary anchor: publisher/release-candidate.schema.json#/properties/source_run/properties/run_id and pipeline/run-evidence.schema.json#/properties/run_identity/properties/run_id.

run_evidence_ref.description: Relative path pointer to the run-evidence artifact produced by this run. Pipeline-internal reference only — must not appear in public metadata or be exposed through public API surfaces.

producer.description: Pipeline component or script that produced this run. Vocabulary anchor: publisher/release-candidate.schema.json#/properties/source_run/properties/producer and pipeline/run-evidence.schema.json#/properties/run_identity/properties/producer.

run_type.description: Optional category of the originating run. Vocabulary anchor: pipeline/run-evidence.schema.json#/properties/run_identity/properties/run_type. Pipeline-informational only.

candidate_identity.description: Identifies the candidate this traceability record belongs to. Field names and patterns anchor to publisher/release-candidate.schema.json dataset_identity and release_identity to prevent vocabulary drift.

release_id.description: Stable candidate release identifier. Vocabulary anchor: publisher/release-candidate.schema.json#/properties/release_identity/properties/release_id.

candidate_artifacts.description: Array of artifact traceability entries. Each entry links a candidate artifact role and logical name to its originating run output via a required hash. artifact_hash is required (not optional) to enable hash-mismatch rejection at schema validation time.

artifact_role.description: Artifact role. Vocabulary anchor: publisher/release-candidate.schema.json#/properties/artifact_roles vocabulary keys.

artifact_name.description: Human-readable logical name for the artifact.

artifact_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the artifact. Required to enable hash-mismatch rejection at schema validation time. Pattern consistent with publisher/release-candidate.schema.json#/$defs/artifact_role/properties/sha256.

contract_ref.description: Optional relative path pointer to the JSON Schema contract that governs this artifact's structure.

validation_status.description: Current validation state of the candidate traceability record. Records state only — does not authorize any lifecycle transition. Promotion authority belongs to the publisher layer.

traceability_boundary_confirmations.description: Explicit confirmation that this traceability record is a pipeline-side provenance link only. It does not authorize promotion, registry activation, or any lifecycle transition. Analogous to run_boundary_confirmations in pipeline/run-evidence.schema.json and state_boundaries in publisher/release-candidate.schema.json.

is_promotion_authorized.description: This traceability record does not authorize candidate promotion. Promotion authority belongs to the publisher layer.

is_active_release.description: This candidate traceability record does not describe an active release.

is_published_release.description: This candidate traceability record does not describe a published release.

raw_run_evidence_embedded.description: Confirms that no raw run evidence content is embedded in this record. Only stable identifiers (run_id, run_evidence_ref as a path pointer, producer) are used as run references.
